blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thirteen people allegedly linked to the True Brown Style (TBS) group have been arrested in Metro Manila since August 2024 as police intensify their crackdown on the group over its alleged recruitment of minors for criminal activities. Police records showed that two of the arrests were made in 2024, four in 2025 and seven this year. Read: DILG goes after crime gang recruiting minors Six arrests were made in the Southern Police District, four in the Manila Police District, two in the Quezon City Police District and one in the Northern Police District.
